gloss: to pierce through; to break through; to pass through

definitions.gloss: to pierce through; to penetrate; to go right through
definitions.explanation: To physically pass through something from one side to the other, or to break through a barrier or obstacle.

definitions.gloss: to stand out dramatically; to be strikingly (clear, bright, etc.)
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe something that is exceptionally vivid, clear, or outstanding, as if it has broken through ordinary limits.

examples.japanese: {弾丸|だんがん}が{壁|かべ}を{突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}けた。
examples.english: The bullet pierced through the wall.

examples.japanese: {路地|ろじ}を{突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}けると、{広|ひろ}い{通|とお}りに{出|で}た。
examples.english: After passing through the alley, I came out onto a wide street.

examples.japanese: {雨雲|あまぐも}を{突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}けて、{飛行機|ひこうき}は{青空|あおぞら}の{上|うえ}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: Breaking through the rain clouds, the airplane emerged above a blue sky.

examples.japanese: {突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}けるような{青空|あおぞら}だった。
examples.english: It was a strikingly clear blue sky.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}けた{明|あか}るさに{救|すく}われた。
examples.english: I was saved by her exceptionally bright personality.

examples.japanese: {突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}けるような{高|たか}い{声|こえ}が{会場|かいじょう}に{響|ひび}いた。
examples.english: A piercingly high voice echoed through the venue.

notes:
Compound verb from {突|つ}く (to thrust, to poke) + {抜|ぬ}ける (to come out, to pass through). The combination emphasizes forceful passage through a barrier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壁|かべ}を{突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}ける: to pierce through a wall
- {突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}けるような{青空|あおぞら}: a strikingly clear blue sky
- {突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}けるような{声|こえ}: a piercing voice

TRANSITIVITY:
Both transitive (を) and intransitive usage. Takes を when specifying what is being pierced through.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {貫|つらぬ}く: to penetrate, pierce — emphasizes going all the way through
- {通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}ける: to pass through — more neutral, less forceful
